changelog.change: Initial served deny-list: 55 function words and 14 proper nouns, each with the reason it is off the board.
changelog.why: Row 16 - the 32,310 words the anagram served included Tamil's grammar and the personal names and mastheads a news corpus makes frequent, and because frequency is a difficulty axis they landed in the EASY band, which is the band a player meets most. No gate the lexicon can express separates them: a part-of-speech rule was measured and rejected because pos is a union across 21 sources, so appa and arasu both carry interjection. A named list with a reason per entry is the honest shape for a judgement no column carries.

note: Every word here is real Tamil, is attested, and STAYS in the published lexicon - the exclusion is on SERVING only. The list is named one word at a time because no lexicon column separates grammar from vocabulary: pos is a UNION across 21 sources, so அப்பா (father) and அரசு (government) both carry interjection, and a part-of-speech rule would have deleted them. These 27 were reviewed alongside the denied words and deliberately KEPT - do not add them: அப்பா, அம்மா, அரசு, பக்கம், மாதிரி, கொஞ்சம், நிறைய, ஒன்று, இரண்டு, மூன்று, நான்கு, ஐந்து, ஆயிரம், இன்று, பிறகு, அடுத்து, அருகில், எதிராக, காரணமாக, உடனடியாக, இப்படி, எப்படி, செல்வன், ஆதவன், நம்பி, அகில், இந்து. Add an entry only when the WORD ITSELF makes a bad puzzle answer, never because it looked grammatical, and write the reason beside it.
